groups.meta: 15% of all affinity converts to standing

rows.label: The Perrin Sequence pledge
rows.note: every mission counts, no special missions

conditions: New Loka is allied (+50% Perrin standing) and Arbiters of Hexis is opposed (-50%). Pledge Perrin or New Loka first.

Steel Meridian is Perrin's enemy (-100%): its standing drains every mission while you are pledged to Perrin or New Loka, uncapped by the daily cap. One player lost about 200,000 in a single mission at rank 5.
Standing can go negative down to the rank -2 floor (-44,000), which brings Eximus MOA hunters.
bonuses: You can swap pledges freely with no penalty.

groups.activity: earn standing and rank up in the syndicate screen
groups.meta: the daily cap is the bottleneck
conditions: The weapon costs 125,000, above the 99,000 Partner minimum, so you keep farming past the rank-up.
It cannot be picked as the free Partner reward; it is a separate standing purchase.
bonuses: Spending standing can drop your rank, which no longer matters once you own it.

disclosures.title: the credit trait
disclosures.body: Hotfix 42.0.10 nerfed the stalled-gas multi-payout trick. It is now a modest credit bonus, about 2x at MR 8 rising to about 4x at MR 18 and capped.
